name: Blob World
summary: Motion design and illustration made from strange 3D renders: soft blobs, surreal rooms, clay, fur, jelly and inflatable textures, sometimes uncanny. It is an illustration world, not a component style: glassmorphism and 3D UI style the controls; Blob World fills the picture.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make the screen a toy world: soft, over-lit 3D bodies with odd textures carry the brand, and the interface stays plain around them.
design_principles: Build each figure from rounded volumes with no sharp edge: a minimum radius of 24% of the shape width.
Render one hero scene per page at 1600px or wider, with a soft key light from the top left and a shadow of 40px to 80px blur.
Give each surface one tactile material: clay, fur, jelly, inflatable plastic or felt, with a visible grain at 100% zoom.
Use a palette of 3 saturated hues on a pastel ground (#FFE9D6), with one acid accent.
Place 3 to 7 floating shapes around the hero at 3 depths, with sizes in a ratio of 1 : 2 : 4.
Set type in a rounded, heavy face (weight 600 to 700) at 56px or larger for display, and keep body text at 18px in a plain ground block.
Loop motion for 4s to 8s: bodies squash and stretch by 6% to 12%, and drift by 8px to 24px.
anti_patterns: Flat vector figures with no volume
Frosted glass panels as the main image
Dark, realistic lighting with deep shadow
Dense data tables beside the render

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose 12-column grid with one large render that breaks the grid; text blocks sit in a plain column of 5 to 6 columns.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred or flush-left text beside the render; floating shapes cross the grid edge by 16px to 64px.
layout.container_geometry: Containers with a 32px radius; pill buttons at 999px; round and bean shapes for accents.

font_pairings.note: A soft, rounded display face with a friendly, legible text face.
A heavy, round face that echoes the volume of the renders.
A slightly rounded sans for brands that need a plainer voice.

hierarchy_rules: Set display in sentence case, not upper case.
Keep one heavy weight for headlines and one regular weight for text.

color.palette_structure: A pastel ground with 3 saturated render hues and one acid accent.
color.contrast_rules: Body text uses ink (#2A1740) on the pastel ground at 12:1; saturated hues carry shapes and buttons, and button text uses ink.
color.surface_treatment: Soft diffuse shading with subsurface glow; a visible material grain at 3% to 6%; no hard specular lines.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft key light from the top left; shadows of 40px to 80px blur at 20% to 30% opacity in a tinted hue, not black.

materiality.surface_simulation: Rendered clay, jelly, fur, felt and inflatable plastic, lit in a soft studio.
materiality.border_rules: No borders on shapes; interface cards use a 1px line at 12% ink opacity.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Shadows of 40px to 80px blur under floating bodies; no backdrop blur on interface parts.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Soft solid glyphs at 24px with round caps, placed on a 40px circle tile in a render hue.
ornamentation_details.illustration: 3D blob characters, surreal rooms, melting shapes and floating props, rendered in Blender, Cinema 4D or Spline.

motion.transition_physics: Soft and elastic: bodies squash and stretch by 6% to 12%; shapes drift by 8px to 24px in loops of 4s to 8s; page elements spring in with one overshoot of 8%.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the element to 1.06 and tilts it by 3°; active squashes it to 0.96.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful curiosity and a mild unease at bodies that are too soft to be real.

avoid_when: The page loads on slow networks and cannot carry a heavy render.
The product is a dense data tool.
The brand needs a sober, institutional tone.

modifiers.how: Replace renders with 2-hue vector shapes and remove shadows; keep the rounded forms and pastel ground.
Put the controls on frosted panels of 16px to 24px blur over the render; keep the palette.
Swap blobs for flat figures with long limbs and 3 shape accents; keep the saturated hues.

pack.why: Soft, filled forms with round terminals match the volume of the renders.

ground.why: Blob world places soft round masses of colour behind the content.
